long_biography.plain_text:
Alexander Grigoryevich Abramov studied at the Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology, earning a doctorate in physics and mathematics before working at the Academy of Sciences' Institute of High Temperatures. He then moved into commercial activity, founding EvrazMetall in 1992 and developing a metals-trading platform that expanded into industrial ownership.

Abramov and long-time partner Alexander Frolov built the business that became Evraz by acquiring and reorganising steelmaking and raw-material assets. Abramov served at different times as chief executive, director and chairman, overseeing the group's development into an international producer with integrated steel and mining operations. He left the board in 2022, but Evraz remains the central enterprise in his business record and the principal foundation of his wealth.
